title: CrystalJev: thinking fast and slow with atomistic foundation models for materials discovery
title_zh: CrystalJev：用原子基础模型快速和慢速思考材料发现
summary: 原子基础模型对数百万种假设材料进行分类，但用作缓慢的模拟器，其阈值能量按表面值计算。他们最好被解读为快速决策者。 CrystalJev 对每个非松弛结构查询一次冻结的原子间势，并通过校准概率、有限样本保证以及何时缓慢思考的规则来回答键入的问题。在 65 个 Matbench Discovery 模型中，“稳定”判定是一种变相的概率，由模型的错误和候选群体来解释。
abstract: arXiv:2610.06985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomistic foundation models triage millions of hypothetical materials but are used as slow simulators, their thresholded energies taken at face value. They are better read as fast decision-makers. CrystalJev queries a frozen interatomic potential once per unrelaxed structure and answers typed questions with calibrated probabilities, finite-sample guarantees and a rule for when to think slowly. Across 65 Matbench Discovery models, a 'stable' call is a probability in disguise, explained by a model's errors and the candidate population. Once trained, one forward pass decides nearly as well as a relaxation at a thirtieth of its cost, and a value-of-information theory sends slower computation only where decisions can change. The same layer answers electronic, mechanical and molecular questions. In a registered prospective test with 700 new density-functional calculations, single-pass forecasts calibrated only on existing data over-stated the stable fraction of unseen candidates (5.8%) by at most 2.1 percentage points.

title: Mechanical properties of V-4Ti-4Cr alloy from molecular dynamics with a neural-network potential
title_zh: 通过神经网络势的分子动力学研究 V-4Ti-4Cr 合金的机械性能
summary: 机器学习原子间势能够对与聚变应用相关的钒合金进行大规模原子模拟，但在多组分系统中可靠的训练和验证仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们使用两阶段工作流程为 V-Ti-Cr 系统开发基于描述符的 DeepMD-DPA1 潜力：由 MatterSim 基础模型驱动的广泛配置采样，然后微调到使用 VASP 计算的密度泛函理论数据。该模型的能量均方根误差为 9.2 meV/原子，力分量的均方根误差为 0.23 eV/埃。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials enable large-scale atomistic simulations of vanadium alloys relevant to fusion applications, but reliable training and validation remain challenging in multicomponent systems. Here, we develop a descriptor-based DeepMD-DPA1 potential for the V-Ti-Cr system using a two-stage workflow: broad configuration sampling driven by the MatterSim foundation model followed by fine-tuning to density-functional-theory data computed with VASP. The model achieves root-mean-square errors of 9.2 meV/atom for energies and 0.23 eV/angstrom for force components. Using this potential in large-cell LAMMPS simulations, we compute Young's modulus, bulk modulus, and Poisson's ratio for V-4Ti-xCr and V-xTi-4Cr alloys at T = 300 K and T = 1073 K. We find that increasing Cr fraction increases the elastic moduli of the alloy, while increasing Ti fraction decreases them; all compositions are softer at 1073 K than at 300 K. Two-phase simulations give a melting temperature for pure V of 1950 K, in good agreement with experimental data.

title: Defect-limited thermal transport in AlN using pretrained machine-learning interatomic potentials
title_zh: 使用预训练的机器学习原子间势在 AlN 中进行缺陷限制热传输
summary: 氮化铝（AlN）是一种重要的热管理材料，其高晶格热导率受到氧杂质的强烈抑制。我们使用预先训练的通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)、分子动力学 (MD) 和声子玻尔兹曼输运计算来研究与氧相关的缺陷引起的声子散射。几个预训练的 MLIP 以声子色散和原始热导率的密度泛函理论为基准。为了平衡精度和计算速度，我们使用紧凑 SevenNet-Nano 模型的微调版本进行 MD 模拟。蒙特卡罗退火支持结合 VAₗ(O_N)₃ 配合物的形成，其散射与其孤立成分的散射不同。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Aluminum nitride (AlN) is an important thermal management material whose high lattice thermal conductivity is strongly suppressed by oxygen impurities. We investigate phonon scattering by oxygen-related defects using pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), molecular dynamics (MD), and phonon Boltzmann transport calculations. Several pretrained MLIPs are benchmarked against density functional theory for phonon dispersions and pristine thermal conductivity. To balance accuracy and computational speed, we use a fine-tuned version of the compact SevenNet-Nano model for MD simulations. Monte Carlo annealing supports the formation of bound VAₗ(O_N)₃ complexes, whose scattering differs from that of their isolated constituents. Defect scattering rates extracted from excess spectral energy density (SED) linewidths agree reasonably with harmonic T-matrix predictions at low oxygen contents, supporting the independent-scatterer approximation. Incorporating these rates into an iterative Boltzmann transport equation with Bose--Einstein statistics yields thermal conductivities comparable to experimental values and captures their observed decrease with oxygen content. At high concentrations, however, the scattering rate deviates from linear scaling with oxygen content, suggesting limitations of independent-defect and pristine-phonon descriptions. These results demonstrate an efficient approach using pretrained MLIPs to quantify defect-limited thermal transport and provide insights into impurity effects beyond the dilute-defect approximation.

title: Targeted fine-tuning of machine-learning interatomic potentials for phonons and phase transitions
title_zh: 对声子和相变的机器学习原子间势进行有针对性的微调
summary: 对声子和相变的机器学习原子间势进行有针对性的微调
abstract: npj Computational Materials, Published online: 07 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02338-w Targeted fine-tuning of machine-learning interatomic potentials for phonons and phase transitions

title: Machine learning Majorana topology using unsupervised and supervised learning
title_zh: 使用无监督和监督学习的机器学习马约拉纳拓扑
summary: 在无监督学习中，深度学习的训练数据不带有任何标签，从而迫使算法发现数据中隐藏的模式以辨别有用的信息。原则上，这可能是识别拓扑顺序的有力工具，因为拓扑并不总是以明显的物理方式（例如拓扑超导性）来体现其决定性的确认。然而问题在于，无监督学习是一项艰巨的挑战，需要大量的计算资源，而这可能并不总是有效。在当前的工作中，我们结合无监督和监督学习来建立现实短无序纳米线中马约拉纳分裂中的未标记（模拟）数据，不仅可以区分“拓扑”和“平凡”，还可以区分它们在相关参数空间中发生的交叉。
abstract: arXiv:2512.13825v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In unsupervised learning, the training data for deep learning does not come with any labels, thus forcing the algorithm to discover hidden patterns in the data for discerning useful information. This, in principle, could be a powerful tool in identifying topological order since topology does not always manifest in obvious physical ways (e.g., topological superconductivity) for its decisive confirmation. The problem, however, is that unsupervised learning is a difficult challenge, necessitating huge computing resources, which may not always work. In the current work, we combine unsupervised and supervised learning to establish that unlabeled (simulated) data in the Majorana splitting in realistic short disordered nanowires may enable not only a distinction between `topological' and `trivial', but also where their crossover happens in the relevant parameter space. This may be a useful tool in identifying topology in experimental Majorana nanowires.

title: Light-Field-to-Bits Computing via an Online-Trainable Cascaded Optoelectronic Neural Network
title_zh: 通过可在线训练的级联光电神经网络进行光场到比特计算
summary: 光学计算通过光场的不断演化来编码和处理信息，而数字电子系统则在离散逻辑状态下运行。传统的光电接口将测量的光学响应转换为电子可访问的数据，随后在电子域中执行特定任务的解释。在这里，我们介绍并实验验证了概念验证光场到比特 (LFB) 计算架构，该架构将承载信息的光场映射到预定义的 4 位码字上。所提出的架构包括两个级联衍射层，它们将输出平面上的光能路由到八个预定义的感兴趣区域（ROI），这些区域排列为四个差分对，每对通过相对强度比较编码一位。
abstract: Optical computing encodes and processes information through the continuous evolution of optical fields, whereas digital electronic systems operate on discrete logical states. Conventional optical-to-electronic interfaces convert measured optical responses into electronically accessible data, with task-specific interpretation subsequently performed in the electronic domain. Here, we introduce and experimentally validate a proof-of-concept light-field-to-bits (LFB) computing architecture that maps information-bearing light fields onto predefined 4-bit codewords. The proposed architecture comprises two cascaded diffractive layers that route optical energy at the output plane into eight predefined regions of interest (ROIs) arranged as four differential pairs, with each pair encoding one bit through relative-intensity comparison. We physically implement the first diffractive layer and computationally emulate the second, using a CMOS sensor to capture the intermediate intensity distribution. We further develop a differentiable physics-assisted surrogate model within a camera-in-the-loop framework. The experimental prototype achieves 4-bit codeword accuracies of 95.31% for geometrically perturbed hexadecimal inputs and 93.36% for traffic-sign inputs subjected to combined viewpoint distortion and noise. Meanwhile, the optical front-end exploits the intrinsic parallelism of diffractive propagation, performing high-dimensional optical transformations equivalent to ∼51.2 Giga-Operations (GOPs) of multiply accumulate (MAC) operations within a ∼1.16 ns optical time-of-flight, while the electronic stage only performs lightweight spatial aggregation at the scale of tens of Mega-FLOPs. This strategy establishes the feasibility of LFB computing as an interface between continuous optical information processing and discrete digital decision-making for latency-sensitive machine vision and edge sensing.

title: Reliability of AI/ML Computational Searches for Magnetic Materials: Databases, Validation, and Synthesizability
title_zh: 磁性材料 AI/ML 计算搜索的可靠性：数据库、验证和可合成性
summary: 用于材料发现的 AI/ML 方法的快速发展提高了计算数据库的质量、物理完整性和信息内容的重要性。我们研究了磁性材料的这些问题，其中竞争磁态、化学无序和有限温度特性的不完整采样可能导致表面上准确但物理上不可靠的预测。我们提出了一种分层发现工作流程，将独立的机器学习模型与显式电子结构、磁性、动力学、热力学、动力学和实验验证相结合。为了将动力学可及性纳入高通量筛选中，我们引入了基于化学有序无序与塔曼温度之间的关系的无量纲合成窗口描述符。
abstract: arXiv:2610.07552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid growth of AI/ML methods for materials discovery has increased the importance of the quality, physical completeness, and information content of computational databases. We examine these issues for magnetic materials, where incomplete sampling of competing magnetic states, chemical disorder, and finite-temperature properties can lead to apparently accurate but physically unreliable predictions. We propose a hierarchical discovery workflow combining independent ML models with explicit electronic-structure, magnetic, dynamical, thermodynamic, kinetic, and experimental validation. To incorporate kinetic accessibility into high-throughput screening, we introduce a dimensionless synthesis-window descriptor based on the relation between the chemical order-disorder and Tammann temperatures. A cluster-expansion analysis of Fe-Co-B illustrates the importance of this criterion: although ordered Fe3CoB2 is energetically favored at T=0, its small ordering energy produces an order-disorder temperature far below room temperature, making long-range Fe/Co ordering kinetically unachievable. These results demonstrate that reliable AI/ML discovery of magnetic materials requires databases and validation procedures that contain physical information relevant to the target functionality, rather than simply larger numbers of calculated structures.

title: An Extensible Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations
title_zh: 用于原子模拟专家级自动化的可扩展Agentic框架
summary: 传统上，原子模拟一直受到从头方法的计算缩放限制和经验力场的参数化开销的限制。最近出现的通用机器学习原子间电位显著减轻了这些瓶颈，以很小的计算成本在不同的化学空间提供近量子精度和可推广性。然而，这种转变将瓶颈转移到了人类层面：投入准备和数据分析等耗时的机械过程现在占据了研究生命周期的主导地位。我们介绍了Paimon ，这是一个用于材料优化和纳米级模拟的代理集成的平台。
abstract: arXiv:2606.09422v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traditionally, atomistic simulation has been constrained by the computational scaling limits of ab initio methods and the parameterization overhead of empirical force fields. The recent emergence of universal machine learning interatomic potentials has significantly mitigated these bottlenecks, offering near-quantum accuracy and generalizability across diverse chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. However, this shift has relocated the bottleneck to the human dimension: time-consuming mechanical processes, such as input preparation and data analysis, now dominate the research lifecycle. We introduce Paimon, a Platform for Agentic Integration in Materials Optimization and Nanoscale-simulations. Through hundreds of trials on an expert-level liquid electrolyte simulation, we show that Paimon substantially improves the reliability of agentic workflows by suppressing silent errors: plausible yet physically incorrect results. Paimon accommodates a new capability without modifying the agents already present, which we demonstrate by integrating an externally developed scientific agent. As an agent harness for atomistic simulations, Paimon affords researchers a continuous, science-centric workflow throughout the entire simulation lifecycle.

title: Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models
title_zh: 物理有效的生物分子扩散模型的推理时间投影
summary: AlphaFold 3 型共折叠模型以高结构精度预测生物分子复合物，但其输出的很大一部分在物理上是无效的：链在界面处重叠、配体键长和角度扭曲、环非平面、立体中心倒置。当前的方法要么使用物理信息势来引导采样器，这会增加采样成本和内存开销，从而无法在大型复合体上进行推理，要么对模型进行微调，这会花费时间并将修复与一种架构联系起来。我们观察到，与结构准确性不同，物理有效性在推理时可以根据采样器已经持有的数量进行完全验证。
abstract: arXiv:2610.07037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, hatx₀: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

title: Learning consistent molecular mechanics force fields from first principles
title_zh: 从第一原理学习一致的分子力学力场
summary: 即使机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 接近从头开始的精度，经典力场 (FF) 仍然是大规模模拟的主力。它们将总构型能量分解为简单有效的相互作用，其参数传统上是根据原子或键类型分配的，从而实现高效的模拟，但也限制了它们适应构型的能力。最近的机器学习方法通过将这些 FF 中的键合参数推断为局部原子环境的函数，提高了它们的准确性和可转移性，但仍然依赖于经验非键合参数进行实际模拟。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08020v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical force fields (FFs) remain the workhorse for large-scale simulations even as machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approach ab initio accuracy. They decompose total configuration energies into simple effective interactions whose parameters are traditionally assigned based on atom or bond types, enabling efficient simulations but also limiting their ability to adapt across configurations. Recent machine learning approaches have improved the accuracy and transferability of bonded parameters in these FFs by inferring them as functions of local atomic environments, but still rely on empirical nonbonded parameters for practical simulations. In this work, we introduce a unified approach, textttgrappa-fullFF, which learns both bonded and nonbonded parameters emphconsistently and simultaneously from ab initio reference data. By incorporating physically inspired regularization via supervision of the electrostatic potential and an architecture that facilitates charge equilibration, our model recovers accurate electric response properties, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on geometry optimization benchmarks, and reproduces the conformational sampling of both classical and existing machine-learned FFs, without relying on externally assigned nonbonded parameters.

title: Contact-Governed Macroscopic Signatures of Strain-Induced Valley Sorting in MoS₂ Field-Effect Transistors
title_zh: MoS2 场效应晶体管中应变诱导谷排序的接触控制宏观特征
summary: 应变工程是控制单层过渡金属二硫属化物中谷选择性输运的主要途径。这种量子效应是否在完全接触的设备中持续存在仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。量子传输模型捕获了潜在的谷偏转，但仅限于孤立的纳米级碎片，因此不清楚完整的设备是否记录了整体、接触处或根本上的应变引起的谷排序。在这里，应变单层 MoS2 的量子谷偏转张量直接嵌入到宏观泊松漂移扩散模型中，将这种物理现象扩展到完整的、包含接触的器件。
abstract: arXiv:2610.07203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strain engineering is a leading route to control valley-selective transport in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. Whether this quantum effect survives inside a fully contacted device remains an open question. Quantum transport models capture the underlying valley deflection but are limited to isolated nanoscale fragments, leaving it unclear if a full device registers strain-induced valley sorting in the bulk, at the contacts, or at all. Here, the quantum valley-deflection tensor of strained monolayer MoS₂ is embedded directly into a macroscopic Poisson-drift-diffusion model, extending this physics to a complete, contact-inclusive device. Applying this framework to a 300~nm monolayer MoS₂ transistor with a 3~nm HfO₂ gate dielectric at 77~K, under a localized 6.14~T pseudo-magnetic strain field, shows the resulting 63.6% suppression of the ON-state current is not a bulk property. It is set almost entirely by the source and drain metal-semiconductor interfaces. The full suppression is reproduced when only the 15~nm contact regions are strained and nearly vanishes when the channel interior alone is strained, identifying the metal contact as the dominant site of strain-induced valley physics. Observing it requires tunneling-transparent, degenerately-doped contacts, since classical Ohmic barriers overwhelm the topological signal. A transmission-line analysis reduces this behavior to a single valley-topological contact resistance (Rc,V) and a predictive inverse-length scaling law. This framework applies to any strain-engineered 2D-material heterostructure and can be tested with standard multi-length contact structures. Ultimately, these results identify the metal-semiconductor interface as the decisive location for engineering and detecting valley-selective transport in real 2D-material devices.

title: Dynamic Kinetic Evaluation Favors Compositionally Diverse Multicomponent Alloy Nanoparticles for Hydrogen Evolution
title_zh: 动态动力学评估有利于成分多样的多组分合金纳米颗粒的析氢
summary: 高熵合金 (HEA) 纳米粒子提供化学上多样化的催化位点，但在其巨大的设计空间中确定最佳成分仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了一个框架，结合了机器学习能量预测、热力学蒙特卡罗采样、贝叶斯优化和动力学蒙特卡罗 (kMC) 模拟，以在析氢反应的九元素组成空间中筛选 85 个原子纳米颗粒模型。基于吸附能的静态优化选择了富含 Pt 的低成分组合物，而基于 kMC 的优化将多元素组合物 Au33Co20Cu6Pd26 在评估的候选物中排名最高。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-entropy alloy (HEA) nanoparticles offer chemically diverse catalytic sites, but identifying optimal compositions across their large design space remains challenging. We developed a framework combining machine-learning energy prediction, thermodynamic Monte Carlo sampling, Bayesian optimization, and kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations to screen 85-atom nanoparticle models across a nine-element composition space for the hydrogen evolution reaction. Static optimization based on adsorption energies selected Pt-rich, low-component compositions, whereas kMC-based optimization ranked the multielement composition Au₃₃Co₂₀Cu₆Pd₂₆ highest among the evaluated candidates. Cycle-resolved analysis further showed hydrogen adsorption at Co/Pd-rich environments, migration through intermediate-binding sites, and frequent Heyrovsky desorption at weaker-binding, Au-containing environments. This pathway-level evidence supports a multisite reaction picture and illustrates how incorporating kinetics can complement static adsorption-energy screening.

title: A numerical and efficient model for thermo-field electron emission calculations
title_zh: 热场电子发射计算的高效数值模型
summary: 随着电子源尺寸的减小、采用新材料制造或提高性能，热场电子发射的分析公式（即 Fowler-Nordheim 和 Murphy-Good 方程及其基于 JWKB 的扩展）越来越多地应用于其衍生条件范围之外。我们提出了 GETELEC-3，这是一种开源代码，用一维与时间无关的薛定谔方程 (1D-TISE) 的直接数值解来替代它们。已经实施了多种求解 1D-TISE 的方法来测试速度、稳健性和解决方案的不确定性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.07013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As electron sources are reduced in size, fabricated in new materials, or pushed for performance, the analytical formulations for thermo-field electron emission, namely Fowler-Nordheim and Murphy-Good equations and their JWKB-based extensions, are increasingly applied out of the range of conditions for which they were derived. We present GETELEC-3, an open-source code that replaces them with a direct numerical solution of the one-dimensional time-independent Schrödinger equation (1D-TISE). Several methods to solve the 1D-TISE have been implemented to test for speed, robustness, and solution's uncertainty. The Noumerov algorithm is found to be quickest, with the solution uncertainty below 1%, and together with an optimised kernel that advances all electron energies in parallel, the cost of calculating the current density is reduced to a few milliseconds - comparable to the JWKB evaluation. To further boost the calculation speed, especially in complicated barriers, a neural network has been trained on the residual of the logarithm of the semiclassical reference and it reproduces the current density better than 0.4% at a fraction of the computational cost. The code is developed for metals and semiconductors, accepts arbitrary potentials and density of states, and comes with a user-friendly interface and compiled executable to democratise rigorous electron emission calculations and data analysis.

title: OxiGen: Oxidation-State-Aware Crystal Generation
title_zh: OxiGen：氧化态感知晶体生成
summary: 生成模型有潜力通过逆向设计加速无机材料的发现，但生成实验上可实现的晶体仍然具有挑战性。氧化态广泛用于评估晶体的成分有效性并指导无机材料的发现。虽然现有的晶体生成模型可以生成具有电荷中性氧化态分配的材料，但它们很难再现在合成材料中观察到的氧化态分布。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 OxiGen，一种氧化态感知晶体扩散模型，它明确地表示生成过程中的氧化态。 OxiGen 通过使用结构化输出层进行构建来强制实现全局电荷中性，并对有限状态自动机进行精确推理。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08296v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative models have the potential to accelerate inorganic materials discovery by enabling inverse design, but generating experimentally realisable crystals remains challenging. Oxidation states are widely used to assess the compositional validity of crystals and guide inorganic materials discovery. While existing generative models for crystals can generate materials with charge-neutral oxidation-state assignments, they poorly reproduce the distributions of oxidation states observed in synthesised materials. To address this limitation, we propose OxiGen, an oxidation-state-aware crystal diffusion model that explicitly represents oxidation states during generation. OxiGen enforces global charge neutrality by construction using a structured output layer with exact inference over a finite-state automaton. Empirically, OxiGen substantially improves oxidation-state fidelity, generates the highest rate of stable, unique, and novel crystals among evaluated methods, and maintains high compositional validity even under property conditioning.

title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
title_zh: 哪些合金成分，哪些工艺参数？从优化的金属微观结构和织构推断配方
summary: 金属合金的机械性能由其微观结构和织构决定：晶粒的大小和形状以及晶体的取向。该结构又由配方、合金成分以及加工参数决定。合金开发向前推进这条链条，调整结构直到满足目标性能。逆向运行，从优化的结构到生产它的配方，仍然依赖于专业知识。我们问这种倒退的步骤是否可以学习。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08165v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.

title: Atom-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for 3D Atomistic Systems
title_zh: Atom-JEPA：3D 原子系统的联合嵌入预测架构
summary: 大规模自监督预训练重塑了现代机器学习，极大地提高了语言和视觉模型泛化下游任务的能力。尽管近年来深度学习在原子系统建模方面取得了长足进步，但该领域的自监督预训练尚未实现可比的下游泛化。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Atom-JEPA，这是一种自监督预训练框架，受联合嵌入预测架构的启发，通过互补的原子级和子结构级目标，从未标记的 3D 结构中学习潜在表示。我们在大规模分子和晶体数据集上对 Atom-JEPA 进行预训练，并通过对各种下游属性预测任务进行微调来评估其传输性能。
abstract: arXiv:2610.08400v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining has reshaped modern machine learning, substantially advancing the ability of language and vision models to generalize across downstream tasks. While deep learning has driven considerable progress in modeling atomistic systems in recent years, self-supervised pretraining in this domain has not yet achieved comparable downstream generalization. To address this, we introduce Atom-JEPA, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns latent representations from unlabeled 3D structures through complementary atom-level and substructure-level objectives inspired by joint-embedding predictive architectures. We pretrain Atom-JEPA on large-scale molecular and crystalline datasets and evaluate its transfer performance by fine-tuning on a diverse set of downstream property prediction tasks. Atom-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance on molecular ADMET and quantum-chemical property prediction tasks, and is highly competitive in predicting the physical properties of crystalline materials. These results demonstrate the potential of latent-space predictive pretraining to support broad downstream generalization from structural data alone. Code and pretrained model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/khelverskovp/atom-jepa

title: Research on thermal error modeling of high-speed motorized spindles based on SC-ANFIS
title_zh: 基于SC-ANFIS的高速电主轴热误差建模研究
summary: 高速电主轴的热变形是限制精密数控机床加工精度的首要因素之一。提高多速工况下轴向热漂移预测的鲁棒性对于实现高精度热误差补偿具有重要意义。在这项研究中，针对陶瓷球轴承支撑的高速电主轴，提出了一种基于减法聚类自适应神经模糊推理系统（SC-ANFIS）的热误差预测模型。首先，利用有限元方法分析主轴稳态温度场的空间分布特征，并通过热特性实验平台获得不同离散主轴转速下的温度和热漂移数据。
abstract: Thermal deformation of high-speed motorized spindles is one of the primary factors limiting the machining accuracy of precision CNC machine tools. Improving the robustness of axial thermal drift prediction under multi-speed operating conditions is of great significance for achieving high-precision thermal error compensation. In this study, a thermal error prediction model based on a subtractive clustering adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (SC-ANFIS) was proposed for a high-speed motorized spindle supported by ceramic ball bearings. First, the spatial distribution characteristics of the spindle steady-state temperature field were analyzed using the finite element method, and temperature and thermal drift data under different discrete spindle speeds were obtained through a thermal characteristics experimental platform. To reduce multicollinearity among variables, a hybrid method combining fuzzy c-means clustering (FCM) and grey relational analysis (GRA) was employed to optimize ten candidate measurement points into three temperature-sensitive points. Considering that both thermal error characterization parameters and thermal displacement are relative quantities, the SC-ANFIS model adaptively extracted high-density data clustering centers in a multidimensional feature space to determine fuzzy inference rules, thereby alleviating the structural redundancy caused by the conventional grid partitioning method. Experimental results under multiple spindle speeds demonstrated that the proposed SC-ANFIS model achieved improved prediction accuracy and robustness compared with conventional ANFIS, backpropagation neural network (BPNN), and multiple linear regression (MLR) models. The proposed approach provides a feasible modeling strategy for thermal error prediction of high-speed motorized spindles under multi-speed operating conditions. Graphical Abstract

title: Altermagnetism in MnF₂: Band Splitting and Its Physical Consequences
title_zh: MnF ₂中的Altermagnetism ：能带分裂及其物理后果
summary: MnF ₂被广泛认为是一种候选变磁体，但其变磁带分裂的幅度和影响仍然存在争议。使用电子结构计算，我们构建了捕获MnF ₂的磁性和电子特性的最小模型。这些模型表明，控制手性磁子分裂和电子带自旋分裂的参数相对较小。此外，电子系统处于强耦合状态，其中大多数磁性特性由特征跳变幅度t与大现场库仑排斥U之间的比率t/U控制。因此，所有交换相互作用均缩放为1/U ，因此小的变磁跳变δ t仅产生比例小的交换项。
abstract: arXiv:2606.01515v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: MnF₂ is widely regarded as a candidate altermagnet, but the magnitude and implications of its altermagnetic band splitting remain debated. Using electronic-structure calculations, we construct minimal models that capture the magnetic and electronic properties of MnF₂. These models show that the parameters governing the chiral magnon splitting and the spin splitting of the electronic bands are relatively small. Moreover, the electronic system lies in the strong-coupling regime, where most magnetic properties are controlled by the ratio t/U between the characteristic hopping amplitude t and the large on-site Coulomb repulsion U. Consequently, all exchange interactions scale as 1/U, so a small altermagnetic hopping δ t produces only a proportionally small exchange term. Upon doping, the altermagnetic contribution to the anomalous Hall effect is likewise suppressed, being smaller than the conventional (non-altermagnetic) contribution by a factor of order δ t/U. In contrast, the behavior of the conductivity tensor hatσ(ω) at hbar ω sim U differs qualitatively, because δ t enters the energies of interband optical transitions emphdirectly rather than through the reduced ratio δ t/U. This contribution strongly reshapes hatσ(ω), leading to a dramatic enhancement of the magneto-optical response.

title: Space-time electron wave packets with tunable skyrmion textures
title_zh: 具有可调斯格明子纹理的时空电子波包
summary: 作者：Sharoz Schezwen 和 Yijie Shen 研究人员创建了非衍射自由电子波包，其携带在单个电子波函数中编码的可调谐斯格明子和梅子自旋纹理。通过设计电子的时空光谱，这些物质波表现出传播不变的拓扑结构，将结构光概念与自由电子量子光学联系起来。 [APS 开放科学。 1, 000163] 2026 年 10 月 7 日星期三发布
abstract: Author(s): Sharoz Schezwen and Yijie Shen Researchers have created non-diffracting free-electron wave packets that carry tunable skyrmion and meron spin textures encoded within individual electron wavefunctions. By engineering the electron’s spatiotemporal spectrum, these matter waves exhibit propagation-invariant topological structures, bridging structured light concepts with free-electron quantum optics. [APS Open Sci. 1, 000163] Published Wed Oct 07, 2026

title: Charge order through crystallization of Frenkel excitons: realization in kagome metals
title_zh: 通过弗兰克尔激子结晶的电荷顺序：在 kagome 金属中实现
summary: 电荷序是物质量子态中自发破缺对称性的一个广泛观察和代表性的例子。由于原子内库仑能量较大，这种顺序的电荷重新分布通常意味着材料的电子和晶格特性的显着改变。虽然电荷顺序的标准描述，即费米表面的“电荷密度波”不稳定性，已广泛且成功地应用于优质金属，但其对相关离子材料的适用性相当有限。在这里，我们提出了另一种适用于这些离子材料的电荷顺序一般方案 - 长寿命弗伦克尔激子的结晶。我们在最近发现的戈薇超导体上演示了这种情况，并成功重现了局部电荷相关性和长程有序性实验观察的所有特征。
abstract: arXiv:2510.02289v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Charge order is a widely observed and representative example of spontaneous broken symmetries in quantum states of matter. Owing to the large intra-atomic Coulomb energy, the charge redistribution in such an order typically implies significant alteration of the electronic and lattice properties of materials. While the standard description of charge order, namely a "charge density wave" instability of the Fermi surface, has been broadly and successfully applied to good metals, its applicability to correlated ionic materials has been rather limited. Here, we propose an alternative general scenario of charge order - crystallization of long-lived Frenkel excitons - suitable for these ionic materials. We demonstrate this scenario on the recently discovered kagome superconductors and successfully reproduce all the characteristics of experimental observations on both local charge correlations and long-range ordering. The proposed generic scenario offers a long-sought understanding of charge order applicable to modern correlated functional materials.
